description: Barometer van de stiptheid van de treinen tijdens de piekuren per belangrijke verbinding is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Stiptheidsbarometer van de grote treinverbindingen tijdens de weekdagen. Dit percentage houdt rekening met de afgeschafte treinen. Meer informatie over stiptheid vindt u op de pagina Stiptheid op Infrabel.be. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Brussel, Reizigers, Binnenlandse treinen. The portal shows 2022-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
